reply.text:
Good — parallelism-dependence confirmed.

One thing worth flagging before you close it out: `runInBand: true` serializes the suite, so it removes the symptom rather than the shared state. If that's a deliberate trade (small project, suite runs fast enough), fine — but two things to check later: CI may use a different config or project entry that doesn't pick up the flag, and the underlying shared resource (temp path, fixed port, module-level fixture, DB) will resurface if anyone re-enables workers. Noting it, not asking you to chase it.
